name: 200-via-on-a-segment-interior
why: A 0.8mm via dropped at (5.0, 0.0) — dead centre of a 10mm run, 5mm from either end, and nowhere near an endpoint. Its centre lies ON the centreline, so the gap is 0mm however wide either piece is. This is how a probe pad is strapped to the plane below it, and an endpoint-only via credit scored it as no join at all.
